title: SYMTONY event
description: One event sent to POST /api/v1/events. Send a single object or {"events": [ ... ]} with up to 500 events. Only timestamp and message (or exception.message / name) are required. Unknown top-level fields are ignored; put custom data in context.

id.description: Client event id. Re-sending the same id for the same application is ignored (idempotent).

timestamp.description: When it happened. RFC 3339 with timezone (microseconds kept) or Unix seconds/milliseconds. At most 5 minutes in the future.

severity.description: Alias: level. Monolog names or numeric levels are accepted.

type.description: Defaults to exception when an exception object is present.

name.description: Span or operation name, e.g. "POST /checkout" or "InventoryService::reserve".

environment.description: Overrides the application's environment for this event.

in_app.description: Defaults to true unless the file is under /vendor/.

http.description: e.g. {method, path, route, status}. Stored in context.http.

db.description: e.g. {operation, table, statement (without parameters), rows}. Stored in context.db.

cache.description: e.g. {pool, key, hit, age_seconds}. Stored in context.cache.

external.description: Outgoing HTTP call: {method, host, path, status}.

user.description: Avoid personal data; it is redacted where recognised.

context.description: Any extra data, max 32 KB. Secrets are redacted before storage.
